overall_design: Bob's general message introduces a mandatory, high-priority requirement that all users be added to External-partners before any direct message can be sent, and the restaurant page explicitly blocks the summary DM to Bob until the user population is complete. The breakdown splits the reason and policy (Bob's message as impetus) from the condition and confirmation (restaurant page as final blocker).
